title: Another day (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Garance is a gifted young actress whose raw magnetism and vibrant spirit have yet to earn her the recognition she craves. Living paycheck to paycheck in a small Paris apartment, she feels increasingly suffocated by fleeting relationships, rising anxiety and the grip of an alcohol addiction quietly tightening around her life.

synopsis_lang.en: Garance is a gifted young actress whose raw magnetism and vibrant spirit have yet to earn her the recognition she craves. Living paycheck to paycheck in a small Paris apartment, she feels increasingly suffocated by fleeting relationships, rising anxiety and the grip of an alcohol addiction quietly tightening around her life.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Garance是一位極具天賦的年輕女演員，她未經雕琢的魅力和活潑奔放的精神，卻仍未為她贏得渴望已久的認可。她住在巴黎一間小公寓中勉強度日，並日漸感到窒息。她的生活正悄悄地被短暫的戀情、日益加劇的焦慮，以及酒精成癮纏繞着，並且越收越緊。

cast: Adèle Exarchopoulos, Sara Giraudeau, Sara-Jeanne Drillaud, Anne Suarez
